summary: One compose.yaml with a database and the AI service on a private network: the service name is the address, the password comes from a .env file that stays out of Git, and a named volume keeps the data. docker compose config checks the file without an engine, and a required variable stops with a clear message. The lesson says plainly that no container was started.
goal: M13: Compose with Postgres and the Python service.

items.text: Write compose.yaml, .env and .env.example, and put .env in .gitignore
Run docker compose config --services and config -q, then git status: .env must not appear
Run docker compose up -d --build, fill the table with the ingest and call /health
Remove the password line and read the error, then use @localhost in the address and read the logs
Predict and test what docker compose down and down -v do to the data
Play the Compose Check game to the end and see your score
